verdict.rationale:
Kick's Bill Pay tab explicitly provides a live view of outstanding bills, AP aging, and vendor balances synced from Ramp/BILL (kick-docs-22, kick-supp-invoicing-billpay), directly matching the core story. However, evidence only documents a real-time/current view, not the ability to reconstruct AP aging or vendor balances as of an arbitrary past date; locked-period stability (kick-supp-locks, kick-docs-32) implies some point-in-time reporting integrity but doesn't explicitly confirm historical AP aging snapshots.
missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating AP aging/vendor balance reports as of a specific historical date, independent corroboration of accuracy.
